core_obligations: Set up the group: from a section of the gerbe over the base, take the automorphism group space of that section, which is a base change of the inertia and hence a group algebraic space over the base acting on the section's source (proof lines 6202-6215)

Compare with the quotient: form the quotient of that action and the canonical morphism from the quotient to the gerbe, using that the section makes the structure morphism surjective (proof lines 6216-6230)
Show it is an isomorphism of stacks: the two gerbe clauses imply that the comparison morphism is fully faithful and essentially surjective, hence an equivalence (proof lines 6231-6244)
proof_roadmap: 由截面 s: Y → X 与其自同构群 G = Aut(s)（惯性沿 s 的基变换）作用在 Y 上。
作商栈 [Y/G] 与比较态射 [Y/G] → X；因 s 是截面，结构态射满。
由 gerbe 的两条条件验证比较态射对象满、态射满 ⇒ 是等价。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a gerbe admitting a section is equivalent to the quotient stack of the base by the automorphism group of that section (author lemma at source lines 6182-6200, label lemma-gerbe-with-section). The proof (source lines 6202-6245) forms the automorphism group of the section as a base change of the inertia, builds the quotient stack and the comparison morphism, and verifies that the comparison morphism is fully faithful and essentially surjective using the two gerbe clauses (proof lines 6202-6244). The construction of the group action and the verification of the equivalence are the substance. H3.
